CSC LUMORA W19 - pivots and axes (metres, as drawn in Minecraft = model x 2.10; Minecraft / glTF frame: Y up, front -Z)
base:  origin = bottom centre of the base (standing fixture); hung under a truss the whole fixture is turned 180 degrees about Z
yoke:  pan pivot (-0.0000, 0.2352, 0.0000), pan = rotation about +Y, 540 degrees in total (DMX centre = straight ahead)
head:  tilt pivot (-0.0000, 0.8316, 0.0000) (in the base frame), tilt = rotation about +X, 270 degrees in total, positive raises the beam; head OBJ vertices are relative to this pivot
beam:  origin (0.0000, 0.2059, 0.0000) (head frame), axis (0.0000, 1.0000, 0.0000), lens radius 0.3875, zoom 6-60 degrees
